g.text: Inside al-Kawthar the two registers sit side by side: the GIFT is from “We” (108:1),

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #10243a

g.text: but worship in 108:2 is to “your Lord” (rabb, singular) — never “to Us.”
